sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
Anayama the Peddler
Wolf
Hirata Estate
Juzou the Drunkard
Anayama seeks now to expand his business, but has run short on money, so he offers to sell Wolf some important information about the night they met and a peculiar treasure of the Hirata Estate in exchange for a few Sen.
He'll ask Sekiro to first discover what the Ashina Samurai are in desperate need of and then to bring him a strong man who's willing to pillage the corpses of the battlefields.
When the final attack of the Central Forces hits Ashina, he'll lose his entire stock to the invading hordes and his life too.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- Outskirts Wall - Stairway: before the Sculptor's Idol, he sits beyond the gate guarded by the Cannoneer.
If Kotaro joined him, during the final invasion of Ashina Castle and Outskirts, he'll be found on the other side of the gate were he used to be.
- Estate Path: past the gate behind the two Bandits shouting at Hirata residents to surrender, before the first two Shield-Wielding Bandits.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts (Outskirts Wall - Stairway)
sections.text:
Talk to Anayama and purchase his informations for 10 10.
(Optional) Pay 20 20 to buy the Flame Barrel Memo. If Wolf is already in possession of the Flame Barrel, Anayama will give him Oil [x2].
Once the area is reloaded, Anayama will have some merch to sell and upon leaving him, he'll ask Sekiro to find out what the Ashina Samurai need.

sections.heading: Ashina Castle ( Old Grave )
sections.text: Eavesdrop on the Ashina Samurai and Ashina Rifleman on the bridge to the Great Serpent Shrine.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts (Outskirts Wall - Stairway)
sections.text: Report back to Anayama and reload the area: he will have new items in his stock and, as Wolf's leaving, he'll tell the shinobi that he's looking for a strong man to help him take weapons and armors from the corpses of fallen soldiers.

sections.heading: Senpou Temple ( Shugendo )
sections.text: Retrieve the Red and White Pinwheel on the cliff before the Armored Warrior.

sections.heading: Senpou Temple ( Senpou Temple, Mt. Kongo )
sections.text: Talk to Kotaro and give him the Pinwheel: this will unlock the option to send him to Anayama.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts (Outskirts Wall - Stairway)
sections.text: With Kotaro by his side, Anayama will now have new products in his inventory.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace (Fountainhead Palace)
sections.text: Upon defeating the Corrupted Monk, the Dragon's Tally Board she drops will unlock new items at every merchant, Anayama included.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts (Outskirts Wall - Stairway)
sections.text: After the Divine Dragon is defeated, Ashina will be assaulted one last time by the Central Forces. Anayama, having lost everything to the invaders, offers Wolf his last piece of product, his Promissory Note that discounts the cost of items when purchasing from merchants, for 1 1.

sections.heading: Hirata Estate (Estate Path)
sections.text: If talked in the Hirata Estate memory, Anayama will tell Wolf of a three-story pagoda that might contain a valuable treasure.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- If Anayama is killed in Hirata Estate, he'll also disappear from Ashina Outskirts.
- When one completes his questline with the Promissory Note already in their inventory, a prompt will ask if the player wants to purchase a Dragon's Blood Droplet for 1 1, but if they accept the item received will be a Divine Grass.
- With Patch 1.04 the price of his informations was decreased from 50 50 to 10 10 and of the Flame Barrel Memo from 100 100 to 20 20.
- The only merchant alongside Blackhat Badger to sell Yashariku's Sugars.
- The Phantom Kunai becomes available for 4500 4500 in the Offering Box next to Hanbei after the final invasion of Ashina Castle and Outskirts by the Central Forces, if not purchased prior. It's not necessary to unlock the Kunai from Anayama to have it appear in the Offering Box.
Acquiring this item is a necessary step to unlock the "Master of the Prosthetic" trophy.
- The only merchant who sells an infinite supply of Ako's Sugars.
- His Dragonrot infection doesn't affect his past self in Hirata Estate.
- It's possible to complete his questline even if he's infected with Dragonrot, as long as Kotaro is sent to him.
- Can't be harmed while infected with Dragonrot or at the end of his questline.
